thread:
alex: Kicking off release v2.14 now. Plan: soft-disable feature flag `recommendation-v1` for 5% canary, then 25% after 30m if telemetry is good. Deploy window 23:00-00:30 UTC. I'll post the rollout steps.

 deploy-bot: [deploy] Release v2.14 triggered on cluster-prod-3. Canary group = cohort-llm-5

 jen: copy — please pin model version to `rwd-model-2026-03-20` during canary so we don't get drift :point_up:

 alex: noted. pinning now: ` /infra pin-model --service rec-svc --version rwd-model-2026-03-20`

 sanjay: ops note: if error-rate delta > 2.5% OR p95 latency +150ms -> rollback. Also watch embedding throughput on dedicated nodes.

 maria: added release notes link: https://confluence.redwood/release/v2.14 :memo:

 ops-oncall: I'm on watch. I'll mute non-critical alerts and forward any high-sev to #eng-oncall. :eyes:

 deploy-bot: Canary rollout 5% -> success. Telemetry: error-rate +0.1%, p95 +12ms. Starting 25% ramp in 10m.

 alex: starting 25% now. command:
 ```
 /ff toggle recommendation-v1 --to 25 --reason "v2.14 canary step"
 ```

 jen: monitoring dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/ff-canary/rec-v1

 deploy-bot: 25% -> success. Telemetry stable. No new regressions.

 maria: quick QA found a minor NPE in diff logs but only on internal test cohort. Not blocking for public ramp. :shrug:

 sanjay: let's schedule full 100% ramp in 2h, but gate it behind slowstart and SLO checks. If any canary criteria flips, we cut to 0% and rollback the deployment. Agree?

 alex: agreed. Will open a short change window note to infra and paging: 23:00-00:30 UTC. If we hit rollback, steps:
 1) run `/infra rollback-release --id v2.14`
 2) disable flag fully: `/ff toggle recommendation-v1 --to 0 --force`
 3) unpin model if needed: `/infra unpin-model --service rec-svc`

 jen: adding quick snippet for oncall to execute (copy/paste):
 ```
 ssh ops@canary-proxy
 curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood/flags/recommendation-v1?target=0"
 ```

 ops-oncall: will be standing by. If anything looks suspicious I'll escalate. :thumbsup:

 alex: thanks team — I'll post a post-deploy note once 100% complete or if we abort.
